note: Judged by you on the blind comparison page. Each item is rendered in headless Chromium (no network; Three.js 0.160.0 / 0.128.0 served from suite/vendor), console errors recorded, screenshots saved. 'variant' items are unpublished twists on the well-known prompts.
three_note: Load Three.js 0.160.0 as an ES module from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js (an import map is fine); add-ons such as OrbitControls are under https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/.

items.prompt: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle.
Generate an SVG of a flamingo riding a unicycle while juggling three oranges.

Create a beautiful voxel-art scene of a pagoda in a Japanese garden with cherry blossom trees, as one self-contained HTML file using Three.js. {three_note} The scene must render as soon as the page loads, fill the window, and gently animate (for example a slowly orbiting camera or falling petals).

Create a beautiful voxel-art scene of a lighthouse on a small rocky island at dusk, with animated waves around the island and a rotating light beam from the lamp room, as one self-contained HTML file using Three.js. {three_note} The scene must render as soon as the page loads and fill the window.

Write a playable Tetris game as one self-contained HTML file (plain JavaScript, no libraries). Include: the 7 standard tetrominoes with rotation, a 10 x 20 well, keyboard controls (left and right arrows move, up arrow rotates, down arrow soft-drops, space hard-drops), line clearing, a score, a level that speeds the game up, a next-piece preview, and a game-over screen with restart on Enter. The game starts by itself when the page loads.

Write a playable falling-blocks game like Tetris, but whose pieces are the 12 free pentominoes, as one self-contained HTML file (plain JavaScript, no libraries). Use a 12 x 24 well, the usual controls (left and right arrows move, up arrow rotates, down arrow soft-drops, space hard-drops), a hold slot on the C key, a ghost piece showing where the current piece will land, line clearing, a score, levels that speed the game up, a next-piece preview, and a game-over screen with restart on Enter. The game starts by itself when the page loads.
